annotations.title: JWT, JWS & JWK Security Auditor & RFC 8725 Linter API

description: JWT, JWS & JWK Security Auditor & RFC 8725 Linter API: Audit JWT tokens and JWK sets against RFC 8725 for alg:none, weak secrets, and leaked keys. (Endpoint: POST /v1/jwt-jwk-inspector)

hmac_secret.description: Optional HMAC secret to verify HS256/HS384/HS512 signatures and check RFC 7518 key entropy requirements.

jwk.description: Optional JWK or JWKS ({ keys: [...] }) object to audit for leaked private key parameters (d, p, q, k) and key strength.

max_ttl_seconds.description: Maximum recommended token lifetime (exp - iat) in seconds before flagging long-lived access tokens.

reference_time_unix.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp (seconds) for deterministic exp/nbf/iat validation.

token.description: Compact JWS / JWT string (header.payload.signature) to decode, verify, and audit against RFC 8725.

name: tinplate_jwt_jwk_inspector
